extName.description: Extension name (store list and chrome://extensions). "FocusMode" is never translated.

extDescription.message: During focus in the FocusMode app, swaps distracting sites for “Back to work”. Works only locally.

lang.description: BCP 47 code of this translation, for <html lang> (not shown; zh_CN uses zh-Hans).

phaseUnknown.description: Phase name when the app sends an unknown one.

disconnected.message: Not connected to the FocusMode app

paused.description: Popup: added after the phase name while paused.

badgeOffline.message: FocusMode — not connected to the app
badgeOffline.description: Toolbar button tooltip without the app.

badgeTimer.description: Toolbar button tooltip with the time left.

badgeTimerBlocking.description: Toolbar button tooltip while sites are blocked.

factBlocking.description: Popup: label of the blocking state.

factDomains.description: Popup: label of the number of blocked domains.

factPatterns.description: Popup: label of the number of regex patterns.

showList.description: Popup: expands the list of blocked entries.

listNote.message: You change the list in the file {{file}} — open it from the FocusMode app settings.
listNote.description: Popup note; {{file}} becomes the file name websiteblacklist.txt in code style (keep the marker, never translate the file name).

privacy.message: The extension connects only to the FocusMode app on this computer (127.0.0.1). Nothing is sent to the internet.

skippedHint.message: The browser doesn't support this pattern, or the rule limit was reached — it isn't blocked.
skippedHint.description: Popup: tooltip of a pattern the browser rejected.

patternCountSkipped.description: Popup: number of patterns with the skipped ones.

blockingOff.description: Heading when blocking is off (no app).

hintReadFailed.message: Couldn't read the extension's state. Try refreshing.

hintStartApp.message: Start the FocusMode app. Without it, no site is blocked.

stateOffBreak.description: Popup: blocking state during a break.

hintFocus.description: Popup: under the countdown during focus.

hintFocusNoBlocking.message: left until the break · site blocking is off in the app
hintFocusNoBlocking.description: Popup: under the countdown when blocking is off in the app.

hintBreak.message: left in the break · sites are unblocked
hintBreak.description: Popup: under the countdown during a break.

hintIdle.message: Start a focus session in the FocusMode app.
hintIdle.description: Popup hint when no session runs.

blockedPageTitle.description: Tab title of the blocked page while it loads.

siteWaits.message: This site will wait until the break.

matchLabel.description: Blocked page: label before the matching list entry.

matchDomain.description: Blocked page: label before the matching domain.

matchPattern.description: Blocked page: label before the matching pattern.

timerFocus.description: Blocked page: above the countdown during focus.

timerFocusPaused.description: Blocked page: above the countdown, paused.

headlineBreak.message: Break time! You can open the site
headlineBreak.description: Blocked page headline during a break.

siteHostBreak.message: $HOST$ is unblocked until the break ends.

siteBreak.message: Sites are unblocked until the break ends.
siteBreak.description: Blocked page during a break, address unknown.

timerBreak.description: Blocked page: above the countdown during a break.

timerBreakPaused.description: Blocked page: above the countdown during a paused break.

headlineIdle.message: Focus is over — you can open the site
headlineIdle.description: Blocked page headline after the session.

thisSiteNotBlocked.message: This site isn't blocked right now.

titleUnblocked.description: Tab title when the site may open.

headlineUnblocked.description: Blocked page headline when the site is no longer on the list.

focusLine1.message: This tab will wait. Your task matters more right now.
focusLine1.description: Blocked page: one encouraging line, picked at random.

focusLine2.message: A little more focus — the break is getting closer.

focusLine3.message: One thing at a time. Right now: work.

focusLine4.message: The memes won't run away. Neither will the break.

focusLine5.message: Go back to what you had open a moment ago — that's where the progress is.

focusLine6.message: A small step in your task beats a long scroll.

axolotlLine1.message: Hey! This was supposed to be focus time.
axolotlLine1.description: Blocked page (focus): what the angry axolotl says in its speech bubble, one line picked at random.

axolotlLine2.message: Caught you! This site can wait for the break.

axolotlLine3.message: Uh-uh! Back to your task — I'm keeping watch.

axolotlLine4.message: Not this time. Work first, break later!

lineBreak.message: Step away from the screen for a bit, or have a look here — the break is yours.
lineBreak.description: Blocked page line during a break.

lineIdle.message: No focus session is running, so nothing is blocked.
lineIdle.description: Blocked page line after the session.

lineOffline.message: The FocusMode app isn't responding, so sites aren't blocked right now.
lineOffline.description: Blocked page line without the app.

lineUnblocked.message: This site isn't on the block list any more.
lineUnblocked.description: Blocked page line when the site left the list.

statusBackToFocus.message: Back to focus — the site is blocked again.

statusNoAddress.message: The site's address wasn't saved — open it again from your history or bookmarks.

statusReturnHost.message: Taking you back to $HOST$ in a moment…
statusReturnHost.description: Blocked page notice before going back.

statusReturn.message: Taking you back to the site in a moment…
statusReturn.description: Blocked page notice before going back, address unknown.

statusLoop.message: The site keeps landing here — open it with “Open the site” once the browser stops blocking it.
statusLoop.description: Blocked page notice; names the "openSite" button.

statusReturning.description: Blocked page notice while going back.
